The main responsibility of the Ministry is to protect and safeguard the interests of workers in general and those who constitute the poor, deprived and disadvantage sections of the society, in particular, with due regard to creating a healthy work environment for higher production and productivity and to develop and coordinate vocational skill training and employment services. Government’s attention is also focused on promotion of welfare and providing social security to the labour force both in organized and unorganized sectors, in tandem with the process of liberalization. These objectives are sought to be achieved through enactment and implementation of various labour laws, which regulate the terms and conditions of service and employment of workers. Download on the App Store Frequently asked questions Everything you need to know about using NCS. What is NCS? The National Career Service (NCS) is a one-stop solution offering a wide range of employment and career-related services to the citizens of India, including job search, job matching, career content, counselling, and job fair information. It is an initiative of the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. Who can register on the portal? Job Seekers, Employers, Skill Providers, Career Counsellors, Local Service Providers, Career Centers, Placement Organisations, Households, and Government Departments. Is NCS free to use? Yes. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, or interview processing. Jobseekers should not pay fees to employers. Is a mobile app available? Yes. The NCS mobile app is available for finding and applying for jobs. It can be downloaded from the app store links on the portal home page. How can I avoid fake NCS communication? Some websites and individuals falsely claim an association with NCS or use its logo. Please verify information only on the official website, www.ncs.gov.in . You may contact NCS at support.ncs@gov.in or on the toll-free helpline 1514. Cyber fraud can be reported on 1930. They are fraudulent and tarnishing the image and reputation of NCS. NCS services are free of cost. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, interview processing and other employment related services. Jobseekers should not pay fees to employers. NCS does not endorse or take responsibility for such practices. Copy of application form for issuance of Admit card and appearing in exam.
